Arvo Part's cult piece: 1st record ever in "just intonation"
By Challenge Records Int.
When a renowned string trio collaborates with some of the best vocalists in the
world, the results are nothing short of exhilarating. Such is the case with the
Goeyvaerts String Trio, which is working with Vox Luminis to bring Arvo Part's
"Stabar Mater" to a contemporary audience.

EFTA01133734

 Abramovic Institute: The Founders

Marina Abramovic Institute: The Founders
By Marina Abramovic Institute
Opening a museum is no small feat. The artist Marina Abramovic knows this.
Her performance piece The Artist is Present broke attendance records at
MoMA. Now she is working to create a living, breathing museum for
performance art, where attendees not only visit, but participate. This is your
chance to become a part of 21st century art history.

Naima: Light in the Desert
By Debbie Long
Art can come alive in the strangest of places. That's the premise of Debbie
Long's installation Naima a light and glass installation inside an old trailer in
the middle of the dessert. It's a beacon, a treasure for anyone curious enough
to walk up to the trailer and wonder what's inside.
